title: Whole Curved Cisternae and Rim Buds Golgi Stack
description: One wholly newly authored enlarged complete local Golgi-stack teaching unit, not the entire Golgi ribbon or a whole cell. Four separate complete gently curved flattened cisterna forms retain their full rounded undulating outlines and deliberately visible intercisternal spaces. The cis-most representative has no fenestra, while each later sac has one real off-centre through-opening with finite inner walls. Four complete rim-budding profiles retain both neck and bulb, each rooted in its own parent cisterna. All sac boundaries, curvature, fenestra topology, stack offsets and budding profiles are new; no old chloroplast granum, envelope, stroma floor or intergranum band is extracted, scaled or recoloured. The four-sac scheme and sparse fenestrae are a generic regularized illustration informed by yeast Golgi morphology, not a measured Pichia specimen, universal cisternal count or full taxonomic rule. Thin solid cisterna volumes stand for external membrane-bound sac forms; internal lumens, bilayers, molecular coats, matrix, ER interface, free transport vesicles and cargo are deliberately omitted. Separate sacs are intentional in this suspended cytoplasmic diagram, not mechanically attached shelf plates; the lowest point is only an art origin, with no false pedestal or stability claim. One complete local stack model, zero scenes and no individual-sac counts. Four quiet opaque PBR roles; no labels, textures, transparency, rig, transport, budding animation, biochemical function, medical or diagnostic simulation.
